svg.title: Don’t Storytell: from evidence to a narrative strategy
svg.desc: Understand the situation, propose a supported judgment, form a vision, connect actions through cause and effect, and plan the first promise to keep. Deliver a one-page strategy. Results from real action can change the judgment and the next step.
svg.text: Vision × a coherent path × promises kept
A future worth pursuing, grounded in choices you can make today.

g.text: The situation, direct accounts, constraints, and the decision at hand.
Discover a change, recognize a commitment, or choose what to become.
Keep the evidence, trade-offs, and observations that could change the advice.
Commercial success ∩ social justice ∩ the founder’s convictions
Test one future against all three. Keep uncertainty and conflict visible.
A path built on cause and effect
Each action leaves something that gives the next person a reason to join.
Name the conditions and reasons to change course. Do not promise a fixed ending.
Plan the first promise to keep
Who acts? Who can judge it? What counts? What would make you reconsider?

svg.text: After action, bring back results and counterevidence to revise the path.
Use judgment cards and cases as needed. Ask when a missing answer changes the direction.
